label: Kalari
note: Dogra and Gujjar cheese of Udhampur (Jammu): the curd is set with sour whey, not cooked like paneer, and dried in the sun; fried with salt and onion. Udhampur Kaladi has a GI tag (year given as 2021 or 2023 by different sources).

about.text: Kalari, or kaladi, is a traditional cheese of the Dogra people of Jammu, made around Ramnagar in the Udhampur district from raw full-fat cow or buffalo milk. The curd is packed into small leaf bowls and dried in the sun, so it is dry outside and moist inside, and it is usually fried before eating.

how.label: curdle with sour whey, sun-dry
how.text: Milk is warmed, curdled with the sour whey from an earlier batch, drained, pressed by hand into discs and dried. No temperature is given in any source.
